attributes.law_screen: claim.law.inverted-guard-defeats-equality-chain-range-fold.20260831.v1 APPLIED as the motivating law (post-dates the v3 park, hence genuinely unscreened): its switch-run-collapse clause predicted, correctly, that a switch and only a switch would emit the un-inverted bge-to-body form. claim.law.stack-slots-descend-in-declaration-order.20260831.v1 screened: n/a, no frame or slot component (frames already identical). claim.law.guard-polarity-restructure-fixes-count-parity-not-form.20260831.v1 re-screened per v3: still does not transfer at a 2-instruction guard.
attributes.residual: unchanged at real 4, insns 32/32: target [cmpwi r0,3; bge ->0x28; b ->0x70] vs ours [cmpwi r0,3; beq ->0x28; ble ->0x70]. Every other instruction in the function is identical. SHARPENED MECHANISM, which is the contribution of this revisit: the target's `bge`-to-body / unconditional-`b`-to-exit pair is the UN-INVERTED two-way guard, and MWCC's front end inverts every C guard whose true-target is the fallthrough into a single conditional branch. Axis B (plain if) and axis C (do/while(0)+break) produced BYTE-IDENTICAL results - real 15, insns 32/31, multiset 3t, same `replace T[8:10]=['bge','b'] O[8:9]=['blt']` cluster - which is the two-identical-A/Bs rule and kills the whole if-family axis: the inversion is independent of goto vs structured vs loop-exit spelling. Axis A is the informative one: the switch DID emit the correct un-inverted `bge ->draw` as its first branch, confirming the law's prediction and proving the shape is reachable, but a C switch cannot express an open-ended low run, so the case set {0,1,2} necessarily required a SECOND bound test (`cmpwi r0,0; bge`) where the target has a bare `b`, giving 33 insns; it is also semantically wrong here (it routes negative type to draw, whereas the target's signed `bge 3` routes all values below 3, negatives included, to done). CONCLUSION now stated as a single named mechanism: the target shape requires a conditional branch on the POSITIVE condition followed by an unconditional branch, which MWCC emits only for a switch dispatch, while the semantics require a low run unbounded below, which a switch cannot encode - the two requirements are mutually exclusive in portable C at cflags_demo. Six distinct source forms across v2/v3/v4 now confirm this. Next lever is not another source shape: it is a WebFrank branch-form rule (the residual is 2 instructions, opcode-level, with identical semantics and no register or relocation component) once such a rule class is admissible.
